# Offbeat Vacation

> > Adventure travel booking platform specializing in Himalayan trekking, tours, and offbeat experiences across Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, and Rajasthan.

Offbeat Vacation is an Indian adventure tourism company offering curated trekking packages, camping activities, heritage tours, and accommodations primarily in the Himalayan regions. The platform enables direct booking of tours ranging from weekend treks like Nag Tibba to week-long expeditions in Spiti Valley and Leh Ladakh, with a focus on budget-friendly, all-inclusive packages.
